objective: Make RQ3 paired perception evidence valid by construction: both capture arms are bound to an immutable geographic route, identical effective sensor rig/calibration/weather/timing/capture config, proven frame completeness and a fail-closed claim boundary.

governing_engine.offline_testable: no CARLA import at module level

mandatory_equalities.route_manifest_sha256: content digest of paired_route_manifest_v1 (all capture poses + waypoints + route metadata)
mandatory_equalities.sensor_rig_sha256: content digest of effective post-filter rig (front_only honored), bound to calibration hash
mandatory_equalities.weather_sha256: content digest of ACTUAL world weather parameters (preset name alone is never sufficient)
mandatory_equalities.sim_timing_sha256: synchronous_mode + fixed_delta_seconds + traffic_manager_sync + fps_target + warmup/capture ticks
mandatory_equalities.capture_config_sha256: frames + fps + rig + front_only + seg + lidar_format + vehicle + seed
mandatory_equalities.pair_frame_index: manual and auto arms must expose identical list(range(frames))

governing_engine.equality_decision: every equality is decided by SHA-256 content digest, never by an integer spawn index, preset name or wall-clock value

frame_completeness_gate.policy: PASS requires every expected camera AND lidar to reach its expected frame count with no save errors, no destroyed ego, no sensor failures and no timeout
frame_completeness_gate.expected_definition: expected_frames = len(route_manifest.capture_poses) in THESIS_PAIRED_STRICT mode, overridden by explicit expected_cameras from the pair runner

route_mode.THESIS_PAIRED_STRICT: default for paired evidence; forbids hidden spawn recovery (no shuffle, no fallback spawn, no pose re-projection); ego teleports pose-by-pose (pair_frame_index == pose sequence_index); NPCs disabled

claim_boundary.SENSOR_SMOKE: capture works but is not paired evidence
claim_boundary.UNPAIRED_CAPTURE: single-arm or any failed mandatory equality or route unrepresentable
claim_boundary.PAIRED_PROTOCOL_VALID: all mandatory equalities + route fully representable on both arms
claim_boundary.PAIRED_INGOLSTADT_CAPTURE: PAIRED_PROTOCOL_VALID and manual arm is Grid0821/Grid0828 map-identity and auto arm is an Ingolstadt map-of-record XODR
claim_boundary.town10hd_control: a Town10HD/control arm can never yield PAIRED_INGOLSTADT_CAPTURE

connected_capture_pipeline.runner_contract_wiring: LocalPerceptionRunner gains route_manifest/route_mode/expected_cameras; strict mode writes completion_status into perception_status.json; pair runner writes paired_capture_manifest.json and validates it before exit
connected_capture_pipeline.diagnostic_tool: capture_perception_pair_safe.py is DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; its false-success (any-frame == ok) is fixed and bound to evaluate_frame_completeness

deliverable_gate.live_carla_assay: BLOCKED_EXTERNAL - simulator unreachable (time-out of 3000ms while waiting for the simulator at 127.0.0.1:2000); pair-route correspondence probe (route_correspondence.json) and end-to-end manifest are therefore unverified live and must be marked INCOMPLETE, not pass
